subject: Reminder: Upcoming Team Meeting Tomorrow
body: Dear Team, Just a friendly reminder that we have our monthly team meeting scheduled for tomorrow at 10:00 AM in the conference room. Please come prepared with updates on your projects and any agenda items you'd like to discuss. If you have any scheduling conflicts or need to add an item to the agenda, please let me know as soon as possible. Looking forward to a productive meeting! Best regards, [Your Name]
